definition: Readiness lanes may progress independently. This manifest does not admit or dispatch agents, install code, spend money, publish, or modify production; every consequential operation requires an exact authorization and evidence receipt.

lanes.objective: Prove persistent user-session host, workload lifecycle, release and rollback.
lanes.acceptance: Independent boot, process lifecycle, rollback, and exact running-artifact deployment receipts.

lanes.objective: Finish signed executable installation, updates, capability isolation and verified uninstall.
lanes.acceptance: A permitted app genuinely installs, runs, upgrades, and uninstalls with runtime receipts.

lanes.objective: Enroll attested hardware, prove bounded capacity placement and outage failover.
lanes.acceptance: Two authorized physical nodes transfer idempotent work without admitting shadow-only nodes.

lanes.objective: Make durable tenant-aware state, provenance, synchronization, backup and restore real.
lanes.acceptance: Encrypted backup and restore preserves records, conflicts, history, permissions and tenant boundaries.

lanes.objective: Complete customer recovery, MFA/passkeys and tenant/team authorization.
lanes.acceptance: Real account enrollment and recovery pass user isolation and revocation canaries.

lanes.objective: Hard-test durable queues, retries, dead letters, acknowledgments and crash recovery.
lanes.acceptance: Cross-process replay after forced crash preserves one logical effect and durable delivery.

lanes.objective: Prove Saban formation, authority, checkpointing and NodeSeed-based recovery.
lanes.acceptance: Real admitted mission with exact authorizations, leased nodes, execution and reconciliation receipts.

lanes.objective: Prove provider settlement, canonical order, entitlement, delivered work and refunds.
lanes.acceptance: Independent payment receipt to delivery and balanced reversal, without synthetic revenue claims.

lanes.objective: Finish SDKs, external-client conformance, specialist doors and sandbox.
lanes.acceptance: External client installs and invokes governed capability through working route with receipts.

lanes.objective: Deliver one consistent accessible desktop/mobile OS workspace and app handoff.
lanes.acceptance: Real authorized task continues across mobile and desktop with accurate status.

lanes.objective: Prove public-edge resilience, secret isolation, incident handling and restore.
lanes.acceptance: Independent canary and recovery exercise verify the restored route and persisted data.

lanes.objective: Unify CRM, customers, contracts, fulfillment and financial reconciliation.
lanes.acceptance: Full customer lifecycle with permissioned communications, zero duplicate sends and receipts.
